test_cases.prompt: ground-claim, using the pending literature candidate for resources/ai-for-ux-guide
test_cases.expected_output: Picks the pending target_type='literature' candidate, runs a source-bound /grounding session, writes a one-shot literature note on confirmation, and flips the seeds row to status='discussed' with note_path attached.

assertions.query: SELECT status FROM seeds WHERE resource='ai-for-ux-guide' AND target_type='literature' LIMIT 1

test_cases.prompt: ground-claim, but hand it a raw article URL that hasn't been surfaced yet
test_cases.expected_output: Refuses to process the raw source itself and tells the user to run surface-ideas first.

test_cases.prompt: ground-claim on a candidate whose derived filename already exists on disk
test_cases.expected_output: Stops and asks the user to reword the claim or confirm a genuine duplicate, rather than auto-disambiguating the filename.
